name: android-mcp-server
description: Community MCP server that gives agents control over Android devices and emulators via ADB. The Android-side parallel to XcodeBuildMCP's simulator work — install apps, capture screenshots, drive UI interactions, read logcat.
setup: Requires `uvx` (from astral.sh/uv) — install via `brew install uv` on macOS or per the uv docs.
Requires `adb` on PATH — install Android SDK platform-tools (`brew install android-platform-tools` on macOS).
Connect a device via USB with developer mode enabled, or start an emulator before invoking MCP tools.

Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI run this stdio server. Gemini in Android Studio does not: it supports only HTTP and SSE MCP servers, configured globally in Settings > Tools > AI > MCP Servers (https://developer.android.com/studio/gemini/add-mcp-server). There, use the Android CLI (`android emulator`, `android run`) instead.
Verify the exact install command against the homepage README — the project may have moved to a published PyPI package or alternate install method.
